definitions.scope: every cost_log row = one kernel invocation (worker × iter × batch × layer × section), grouped by pool
definitions.grain: per-invocation (layer/section), NOT deduped — AFD logs per layer/section and those are genuinely different work, so `call` counts align across pools
definitions.batch_tokens: tokens in the invocation's batch, summed over its `groups` (the DP shards one invocation is split across) = the logical batch size
definitions.prefill_tokens: tokens being prefilled in the invocation
definitions.decode_request_count: number of decode requests in the invocation
definitions.pools: reported separately because scales differ: attn workers are DP shards (local slice), the ffn pool is the aggregator (summed batch)
definitions.workers: worker rows retain the exact (pool_tag, worker_id) identity; pool rows are aggregate context across those workers
definitions.stats_vs_scatter: num_calls is exact; report metrics use the regular iter_id-stride sample; payload scatter is then evenly downsampled to <=4000 points per pool or worker
